en.headline: Police investigate oil attacks on two Yau Ma Tei restaurants within 38 minutes
en.dek: Red oil hit a Portland Street cha chaan teng and black oil a Bowring Street dim sum shop early Saturday; no arrests and no injuries reported.
body: Police are investigating two cases of criminal damage after oil was poured over the exteriors of two restaurants in Yau Ma Tei early on Saturday morning.

Officers received a report at about 6:07am concerning a dim sum shop at 22 Bowring Street in Jordan, where black oil had been poured on the sign and walls. About 38 minutes later, at around 6:45am, a cha chaan teng at 46 Portland Street was found with red oil on its large golden sign, external walls, metal gate and pavement.
Staff at both premises used ladders and cleaning agents to remove the stains. Interior fittings and equipment were not damaged, and operations were not affected. No one was injured.

The cases have been classified as criminal damage and are being handled by the Yau Tsim District Crime Squad. Police are reviewing CCTV footage to identify the person or people responsible and are examining possible motives, including debt or other disputes. No one has been arrested.

zh.headline: 油麻地兩食肆38分鐘內遭淋油 警列刑事毀壞追查
zh.dek: 砵蘭街茶餐廳招牌染紅油，寶靈街點心店則被淋黑油，暫無人被捕，亦無人受傷。
body: 警方正在調查兩宗刑事毀壞案，油麻地兩間食肆今早先後遭人淋油。
上午約6時07分，警方接報佐敦寶靈街22號一間點心店招牌及外牆被淋黑油。約38分鐘後，即上午6時45分左右，油麻地砵蘭街46號一間茶餐廳的大型金色招牌、外牆、鐵閘及地面亦被發現染上紅油。
兩店職員其後用梯子及清潔劑清理污漬。店內設施及設備未見明顯損毀，營運未受影響，事件中無人受傷。
案件已列作刑事毀壞，由油尖警區刑事調查隊跟進。警方正翻查閉路電視，追查涉案人士下落及犯案動機，包括是否涉及債務或其他糾紛，暫未有人被捕。
